verdict.rationale: The only sign of API versioning is that several API reference pages sit under a versioned path (/api/v8/, e.g. the metadata, records and bulk-write docs). That implies a versioned REST API, but nothing in the evidence describes a versioning scheme or any deprecation, sunset or migration policy. missing for 10: documented deprecation/sunset policy, explicit versioning policy text (version lifecycle, support windows, migration guidance), changelog or notice process, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy
